events.name: Hidden Stash
events.danger: A concealed cache may be trapped or claimed by bandits.

force_lock.text: The party forces the cache and takes what it can carry.

mark_lock.text: The party marks the cache and continues safely.

empty_cache.text: The party carefully empties the hidden cache.

trace_passage.text: The cache contains a minor arcane clue.

default.text: The hidden stash is left undisturbed.

events.name: Ancient Rune
events.danger: Unstable magic surrounds an old roadside rune.

unleash.text: The rune releases a burst of useful arcane energy.

seal.text: The rune is sealed before it can harm anyone.

extract.text: Fragments of the rune are recovered for sale.

study.text: Careful study reveals an arcane secret.

default.text: The rune fades before it can be understood.

events.name: Passing Caravan
events.danger: A stranded caravan offers opportunity, but the road is exposed.

charge.text: The party clears the dangerous road and earns a reward.

detour.text: The caravan is guided around the danger safely.

loot.text: Abandoned cargo is recovered from the roadside.

scout.text: Scouting reveals a safer route and a small cache.

default.text: The caravan moves on without incident.

events.name: River Crossing
events.danger: A swift river offers a shortcut with uncertain footing.

charge.text: The party powers through the current and reaches the far bank.

detour.text: The party takes a slower but safe crossing.

loot.text: Something valuable is recovered from the shallows.

scout.text: A hidden ford and an old rune are discovered.

default.text: The party crosses without finding anything unusual.

quests.name: Goblins on the Road
quests.description: Goblins have been attacking caravans carrying supplies on the nearby road. You will be paid to protect the roads.
quests.journey: A few seconds along the nearby road.
quests.danger: Goblins attack caravans on the road.

quests.name: Big Bad Wolf
quests.description: It began with animals being taken in the night. Then it was men and women and children. Something bigger than a wolf is out there.
rumors: A hidden stash and old runes lie nearby
quests.journey: A short march into wolf country.

quests.name: Back on the Menu
quests.description: An orc party has been scouted camping nearby. You must travel there and ambush them in the night before they report back to their army.
quests.journey: A brief march to the orc camp.

quests.name: Death is his name
quests.description: An abandoned castle has been taken over by a necromancer. Nothing good can come of this. Rid these lands of this corruption at once.
knownConditions: Death Hex may be used twice
rumors: A mimic may guard a hidden stash
quests.journey: A short march to the abandoned castle.

quests.name: Dont let it wake
quests.description: Cultists have taken over a nearby village and are conducting a blood sacrifice. We dont know what they are trying to summon but we need to stop it.
knownConditions: Enchantment can neutralize one member once
quests.journey: A brief march to the occupied village.
